verdict.rationale: Zep advertises 'Deploy anywhere' with a 'Your VPC' option (zep-docs-17), implying some self-hosted/enterprise deployment path, and its underlying Graphiti framework is explicitly open-source and runnable locally (zep-gh-1/2/3, zep-docs-15/43). However there is no documentation of an open-source core Zep server, install instructions, Docker/Helm assets, or community reports of self-hosting the actual Zep product outside the managed cloud/VPC offering. Missing for 10: explicit self-host install docs for core Zep, evidence of open-source license for the core server, independent confirmation of a successful self-hosted deployment.
